faqs.q: Where can I lodge a general consumer complaint?
faqs.a: You can lodge a general consumer complaint using the dedicated service link.

faqs.q: How do I complain about housing issues?
faqs.a: You can lodge complaints regarding home building, residential tenancy, retirement villages, social housing, or energy/water providers.

faqs.q: What if I need to complain about a government agency or department?
faqs.a: You can make a complaint about a NSW Government agency or contact a specific NSW Government department.

faqs.q: Where can I complain about health care or professional services?
faqs.a: You can lodge complaints about health care practitioners, service providers, or professional services like lawyers and barristers.
